        // Example of direct player input
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {

        });

        // Example of game state progression
        let score = 0;
        document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;

        // Example of restart
        document.getElementById('restart').addEventListener('click', function() {
            score = 0;
            document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;
        });

        // Example of save compatibility
        const saveKey = 'gameState';
        if (localStorage.getItem(saveKey)) {
            score = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(saveKey));
            document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;
        } else {
            score = 0;
            document.getElementById('score').innerText = score;
            localStorage.setItem(saveKey, JSON.stringify(score));
        }

        // Example of responsive layout
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            if (window.innerWidth < 600) {
                document.getElementById('game').style.height = '50vh';
            } else {
                document.getElementById('game').style.height = '100vh';
